entryWatch.trigger: BUY 7 HPE AT A 54.21 LIMIT, struck inside a live 54.20 bid / 54.23 ask at 2026-09-04T13:45:34.444541546Z - one cent off the BID and below the 54.215 mid, deliberately NOT at the offer, because HPE has run 51.6079 to 54.64 in the first fourteen minutes and a limit at the offer would be buying the top tick of a vertical. Target 65.05 (+20%), stop 49.87 (-8%, seven cents above the 9/2 session low of 49.80), time stop the 2026-09-10 bell. FIVE INVALIDATIONS, FOUR OF THEM CLOSING TESTS: close below 51.83 (the 9/2 pre-print close, ALREADY pierced intraday at 51.6079 in the 13:31Z minute and reclaimed inside that minute - recorded in advance so no later run reads the wick as new); close below 51.6079; close below 50.29 (the midpoint of the 45.70-54.88 reaction bar); a TRADE below 49.87; or still open into 2026-09-10, closed at that bell ahead of the ORCL print regardless of price. An hourly seeing any of the first four kills or exits by APPENDING, never by editing, and never by re-striking the level higher.
entryWatch.why:
The reaction bar is the entire argument and it is checkable: 9/3 opened 47.60, low 45.70, high 54.88, CLOSE 54.44 on 72,139,283 shares against a 19-30M base - sold 11.8% below a 51.83 pre-print close and bought all the way back. That is the exact inverse of the GTLB, SAIC, NTNX and OLLI round trips this board refused this week, and it is graded on the same test rather than a friendlier one. The closing-basis invalidations are the deliberate adoption of yesterday's MDT lesson at the only place the rulebook permits it - the next entry's list, written before the fact.

RECONFIRMED AT 10:22 ET BY THE HOURLY, ON A LIVE RE-QUOTE, AND THE LIMIT IS NOT TOUCHED. HPE is 53.97 bid / 54.01 ask at a venue_bid_time of 2026-09-04T14:22:12.952871096Z, last trade 53.9899 at 14:22:13.475684175Z, a 0.04 spread that is 0.074% of mark, -0.83% on the day against the 54.440 official 9/3 close. THE NAME CAME TO THE LIMIT RATHER THAN AWAY FROM IT, which is the opposite of the case the kill rule is written for: a 54.21 BUY limit now sits ABOVE the 54.01 offer, so the specification is marketable and would fill at 54.01 or better - twenty cents INSIDE its own published level, 1.40 better on seven shares. THE LIMIT IS THEREFORE NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED. Not raised, because re-striking a dead level higher is the behaviour this board has refused most often; not lowered, because confirming a specification is not improving it, and an operator executing the published 54.21 already receives the better price the tape is offering. NO INVALIDATION HAS FIRED AND EACH WAS TESTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. Four of the five are CLOSING tests and cannot fire before the bell, and all four are far from their lines on the last print: 53.9899 against 51.83, against 51.6079, and against 50.29. The fifth is mechanical and intraday - a TRADE below 49.87 - and it is the only one a mid-session run could trip: the session low is 51.6079, set in the 13:31Z minute on 198,197 shares, which is the pierce the open recorded IN ADVANCE, and no bar in the fifty-two minutes since has printed lower, so the low stands 1.74 above the stop line and exactly where it stood at publication. THE TAPE SINCE PUBLICATION, WRITTEN OUT BECAUSE THE FADE IS REAL AND NAMING IT IS THE POINT. HPE ran to a 54.64 high in the 13:43Z minute, the specification was struck two minutes later at 54.20 bid, and it has faded since: a 54.41 high in the 13:46Z minute, then down to a 53.11 low at 14:11Z, then a chop between 53.1 and 53.9 for thirty-five minutes and a recovery to 53.975 into 14:21Z. So the entry is roughly a quarter-point underwater against its own limit on an unfilled order, and the name is now BELOW the 54.44 reaction-bar close it was above at publication. THAT IS NOT AN INVALIDATION AND IT IS DELIBERATELY NOT TREATED AS ONE. The setup this entry named was the PULLBACK, not the continuation - it is the stated reason NTAP was refused this morning for EXTENDING above its own 187.45 reaction-bar high - so a fade toward the entry is the setup behaving, not the setup breaking, and inventing a fresher and harsher test at 10:22 that was not written down at 09:45 is precisely the discovered-later exit the rulebook forbids. What the entry pre-committed to is what it is graded on. The screen test it set for itself also still passes on its own terms: HPE at 53.97 remains well ABOVE the 51.83 pre-print close, which is the exact line on which AVGO and FIVE were refused this morning. THE SPECIFICATION HAS ALSO BEEN CONTINUOUSLY EXECUTABLE, which is worth recording because four consecutive entries in this book died unfilled: every one of the thirty-seven minutes from the 13:45Z publication bar through 14:21Z has printed a low at or below 54.21, so this is not a limit the tape never reached.

RECONFIRMED AT 11:22 ET ON A SECOND LIVE RE-QUOTE, AND THE LIMIT IS STILL NOT TOUCHED - BUT THE TAPE HAS DETERIORATED AND THAT IS THE HEADLINE OF THIS HOUR RATHER THAN A FOOTNOTE TO IT. HPE is 52.69 bid / 52.72 ask at a venue_bid_time of 2026-09-04T15:22:06.465577656Z, last trade 52.715 at 15:22:05.857040478Z, a 0.03 spread that is 0.057% of mark, -3.17% on the day against the 54.440 official 9/3 close. THE LIMIT IS NOW 1.49 THROUGH THE OFFER, which is a different situation from the one the 10:22 run confirmed: then the 54.21 buy limit sat 0.20 above a 54.01 offer, now it sits 1.49 above a 52.72 offer, and a limit that far through the market has stopped protecting price at all - in practice the published specification now reads as an instruction to buy at market. An operator executing it fills at 52.72 or better, 10.43 better on seven shares than the published level, and seven shares at 52.72 is 369.04 or 36.50% of the account, further inside the 40% ceiling than the 37.53% it was struck at. THE BREAK IS IMPULSIVE AND IS NAMED RATHER THAN SOFTENED. HPE made a SECOND push to 54.555 in the 14:30Z minute, a LOWER HIGH than the 54.64 session high set at 13:43Z, and then broke from a 53.505 close at 14:43Z to a 52.110 low at 14:49Z - down 2.61% in six minutes on expanding volume including an 87,889-share bar - and has based between 52.11 and 53.04 in the thirty-three minutes since. That is not the quarter-point drift the 10:22 run described. It is a failed rally followed by a break clean through the entry level, and the entry is 1.51 underwater unfilled. NO INVALIDATION HAS FIRED AND EACH WAS TESTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. Four of the five are CLOSING tests and cannot fire before the bell, and all four are clear on the last print: 52.715 against 51.83, against 51.6079 and against 50.29, the nearest of them 0.885 away or 1.71%. The fifth is the only one a mid-session run can trip, a TRADE below 49.87, and it is untouched - THE SESSION LOW IS STILL 51.6079 from the 13:31Z minute, the pierce the open recorded IN ADVANCE, and the lowest print in the hundred and ten minutes since is 52.110 at 14:49Z, so the low has not been revisited and stands 1.74 above the stop exactly where it stood at publication. THE SPECIFICATION IS THEREFORE CONFIRMED AND NOT KILLED, AND THE REASONING IS PRE-COMMITMENT RATHER THAN OPTIMISM. Every test this entry published against itself is untouched, and four of them were made closing tests ON PURPOSE at 09:45 - the MDT lesson adopted at the only place the rulebook permits it, in the next entry's list, before the fact. To kill here would be to substitute an 11:22 judgement for a 09:45 pre-commitment on a line the tape has not reached, which is the discovered-later exit the rulebook forbids, and it is precisely the 10:21 MDT error this board is still pricing daily at 8.36 on four shares. The entry wrote down what would make it wrong in a checkable form so a later run would not have to reconstruct its author's mood; those numbers say it is not yet wrong, and a run that overrides them on a chart is not running this rulebook. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED, and the second half is the harder one today. Not raised, because re-striking a dead level higher is the behaviour this board refuses most often. Not LOWERED to 52.72 either, because lowering is authoring a new entry at 11:22 - this slot's bar for a new mid-session entry is higher than the open's, the daily mandate binds the open and not this run, and confirming a specification is not improving it. ONE DEFECT IS FLAGGED RATHER THAN CARRIED SILENTLY: the published 65.05 target is +20% struck off the 54.21 LIMIT, so an operator filling near 52.72 and exiting at 65.05 would be holding for +23.4%, past the rulebook's take-profit. The 2026-08-10 rule already governs it - exits are struck off the position's OWN FILL - so from a 52.72 fill the target is 63.26 and the unchanged 49.87 stop is -5.4% rather than -8%, tighter than the rulebook requires and therefore not a widening. THE BROAD TAPE HAS DETERIORATED TOO AND HPE IS NOW UNDERPERFORMING IT: SPY is 769.32 bid, -0.50% against a 773.17 settled close, against -0.153% at 09:45. HPE at -3.17% is no longer roughly in line with a soft index the way the open described it - it is 2.67 points worse - and that is recorded as a negative rather than left out. STILL CONTINUOUSLY EXECUTABLE, RE-DERIVED THIS HOUR: of the ninety-seven minutes from the 13:45Z publication bar through 15:21Z, ninety-six printed a low at or below 54.21, the lone exception being the 14:29Z minute at a 54.220 low.
